newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brierley, Southpac restructure j/venture.
newsitem.headline: Brierley, Southpac restructure j/venture.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd and Southpac Corp Ltd said on Friday they had restructured and transfered their joint venture Independent Power Project (IPP) interests to Hong Kong-based AsiaPower Ltd.
The restructuring results in BIL holding 78.5 percent of the company and Southpac 21.5 percent.
AsiaPower's management has the option to acquire a 10 percent shareholding in the company from IPP.
AsiaPower is currently developing over 2,000 megawatts of projects with a primary focus on renewable technologies of geothermal, hydro and wind, together with cogeneration.

AsiaPower chairman Andrew Meehan said the company was now well positioned within the IPP industry to take advantage of new developments as well as acquisition and privatisation opportunities in its target markets.
